summary: Iteration 5 fully validated. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (AI alarm-from-chat creates USD@55 alarm with no [[ALARM]] leak; non-alarm message returns alarmCreated=false; /api/ai/transcribe exists and returns 400/422 for empty/missing file; regressions on commentary, portfolio-advice, ai/messages, /prices, /meta all green). AI assistant mic button (testID ai-mic) present and does not crash on tap. issues: 'Varlık Ekle' FAB slightly overlaps last holding row's P/L text at bottom (cosmetic).

When mic permission is auto-granted by headless browser but recording cannot actually capture, tapping mic once puts UI in a persistent 'Dinliyorum...' state until tapped again. Native (real device) behaviour is fine; consider adding a max-recording timeout or explicit web fallback.

action_items: (optional) Nudge portfolio FAB with extra bottom padding so it does not overlap last holding.
(optional) On web platform, add a safety timeout (e.g. 60s) to auto-stop recording if the user forgets, and/or hide the mic button on web where getRecordingPermissionsAsync silently no-ops.
